description: Known jar SHA-256 fingerprints, keyed by the lowercase hex digest of the whole jar file. Ships empty: JarBench does not fabricate hashes it hasn't verified. Add entries here (or point jarbench.jarFingerprintDb at your own copy of this file) as you positively identify real jars.

<sha256-hex>.label: Human-readable identification, e.g. 'Eaglercraft 1.8.8 client'
<sha256-hex>.notes: Optional free text: where this jar came from, how it was verified, version numbers, etc.
